extensionDescription.message: Finds and decodes Data Matrix, QR and other 2D codes in the displayed email. Works locally and offline.

codesCountOne.description: Overlay header when exactly one code was found.

codesCountOther.description: Overlay header with the number of codes found. $1 = count.

scanning.description: Accessible label of the spinner shown while a scan is running.

minimize.description: Tooltip of the button that collapses the overlay to a badge.

restore.description: Tooltip of the badge that restores the overlay.

close.description: Tooltip of the button that hides the overlay for this message.

overlayLabel.description: Accessible name of the overlay panel.

copy.description: Button that copies a decoded code.

copied.description: Shown on the copy button for a moment after copying.

copyFailed.description: Shown on the copy button when copying failed.

inlineImage.description: Source label for an image embedded in the message body.

sourceWithPage.description: Source label for a PDF page. $1 = file name, $2 = page number.

copyAsHri.description: Button that copies a GS1 code in bracketed human-readable form, e.g. (01)…(17)….

binaryTag.description: Tag on a code whose payload is binary data, shown as Base64.

sourceMore.description: Source label of a code found in several places. $1 = first source, $2 = number of further sources.
